study: FullPool Privileged Patient Geometry Distillation Study

teacher.architecture: exact RETUNED_64D_FULLPOOL convex residual m0 + b + z@w
teacher.fit_only_scaler: exact B8 StandardScaler fitted on current outer-fold FIT R4
teacher.regularization_selection: three deterministic 50/50 FIT episodes per patient; for each scored FIT patient choose lambda using only other FIT patients in the same outer fold/context; patient-equal AP; near-tie <=1e-6 resolved by larger lambda_w then lambda_b
teacher.channel_crossfit: five deterministic label-blind channel folds; fit each teacher on other four folds, predict held-out fold only
teacher.teacher_signal_gate: mean FIT-OOF delta AP >0.03, at least four of five folds positive, MRR and Top1 not materially decreased; require Teacher AP>A1
teacher.metric_scope: all FIT patient channels scored OOF; patient-equal mean across FIT patients and then fold consistency

student_if_teacher_gate_passes.architectural_invariant: exact original A1 network, initialized from corresponding exact A1 checkpoint; no adapter or target conditioning
student_if_teacher_gate_passes.meta_split: deterministic patient-disjoint 80/20 split within each outer-fold FIT group
student_if_teacher_gate_passes.primary_selection: FIT-meta patient-equal AP, then MRR, Top1, simpler/lower KD weight
student_if_teacher_gate_passes.D4_fit_gate: only if D1 or D2 has clear positive FIT-meta AP versus matched D0+
student_if_teacher_gate_passes.target_selection: all Student hyperparameters and checkpoints frozen before any new target outcome metrics
student_if_teacher_gate_passes.primary_kd_comparison: KD versus D0+ continued hard-label control, not merely original A1

statistics.fixed_query: exact active-fewshot deterministic 50/50 assignments; candidate labels ignored by Student

caveat: Inherited A1 VLOO checkpoint selection depends on other validation patients' labels and legacy loader materializes all 80 labels; strict_target_label_sequencing=false. No new target labels are used for Teacher/Student fitting or selection.
